work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXXXIII confirms the Oratory of St Philip Neri at Catania (erected 1799), grants confession faculties and indulgences and communicates the Roman Oratory’s privileges; across page number 197 LF29212, own provenance LF29278, page number 198 LF29281, running titles LF29348 and LF29418; the clause Volumus autem ut Sk aah cit. literarum (LF29469) remains garbled literal OCR; complete 14 April 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF29200–29200; the source closing at LF29478–29481 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. " Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
